lines: Prof. Shashikanth Suryanarayanan's promoter shares above the 20% unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago; this trigger is recent.
They hold 7,150,500 shares, valued at up to ₹966.75 crore (estimate, valued at offer price); shares, not cash.
Minimum Promoters' Contribution stays locked until 9 Sep 2027, so the timing of any liquidity is limited.
Confidence is medium: holdings agree across two sections, but the seller table does not list them.
